description: Positioned overlay centered over (or pinned to an edge of) its containing block. The container needs position: relative.

attributes.name: data-layout-fixed
attributes.description: Position relative to the viewport instead of the containing block.

attributes.name: data-layout-margin
attributes.description: Inset from the edges when pinned to one.

attributes.name: data-layout-contain
attributes.description: Keep the overlay within the viewport, minus the margin, when fixed.
